topic: Exogenous-structure tractability frontier for Beckers structural-simplification actual causation. Fix a finite acyclic total nondeterministic SCM with explicit local tables, a specified actual solution, singleton X=x and Y=y events, and nonnegative rational edge-deletion costs. Under the full-graph reachability-closed and actualized-refinement legality rules, prove that full causal polyforests admit an exact minimum-cost value-path certificate: retained parents hit every bad-row difference support, safe relations compose along the unique path, and an O(L)-arithmetic dynamic program with polynomial bit complexity returns a positive witness, optimum certificate, or separating cut. Prove NP-completeness even for deterministic binary SCMs whose endogenous graph is one directed chain, actual world is zero, and total indegree is at most four, using shared exogenous selector roots and clause gates. Do not claim general treewidth FPT or unrestricted parsimonious certificate counting. Consumer: an explicit-support Beckers backend for the `actualcauses` Python package. PRESOLVE EVIDENCE REQUIRING VERIFICATION: Independent derivations proved the local hitting equivalence, safe minimal-support transitions, forest completion and exact optimum, rational bit bounds, NP membership, and every selector/clause implication of the chain hardness reduction. Checks covered 52,488 local instances, 3,420 forest queries (2,467 ternary), 196 SAT instances, full state/edge cases, and the exogenous triangle counterexample to endogenous-only propagation. Classical HP tree and complexity results do not supply the Beckers-specific full-versus-endogenous separation. Normalized certificates, not unrestricted witnesses, carry the bijection. UNRESOLVED BOTTLENECK: Prove the complete arbitrary-domain compiler and certificate verifier extensionally equal to canonical Beckers causation and minimum deletion cost, including actual-row freezing and topological completion, within the stated explicit-input bound. EARLY KILL TEST: Compare compiler verdicts, optima, and all certificate types with exhaustive legal-edge and alternate-state enumeration on every three-vertex full forest with domains at most three, a fixed five-vertex mixed-domain rational-cost batch, and the exogenous triangle; any mismatch stops extension. STRONGEST-FORM DRAFT (unverified, gaps listed inside): <repo-root>/internal/presolve_drafts/scm_structsimp_exogenous_frontier.md.

open_problems.open_problem: Can an explicit-table compiler and independently checkable certificate format for arbitrary finite-domain acyclic NSCMs be proved extensionally equivalent to canonical Beckers actual causation and minimum rational edge-deletion cost, including actual-row freezing and topological completion?

source_refs.claim: Defines finite-domain nondeterministic SCM semantics with multivalued local functions and preservation of the actual solution under counterfactual evaluation.
source_refs.author: Sander Beckers
source_refs.venue: Conference on Causal Learning and Reasoning, PMLR 275

source_refs.claim: Actualized refinement freezes each actual local row, while structural simplification deletes parents and unions local outputs over their values.
source_refs.author: Sander Beckers
source_refs.venue: Conference on Causal Learning and Reasoning, PMLR 275

source_refs.claim: Provides sound SAT encodings for HP actual causes, but assumes acyclic binary deterministic equations and Boolean complementation.
source_refs.author: Amjad Ibrahim, Simon Rehwald, and Alexander Pretschner

source_refs.claim: Motivates practical actual-cause software for non-Boolean and stochastic systems, but uses adjustable approximate HP-style search rather than an exact Beckers backend.
source_refs.author: Samuel Reyd, Ada Diaconescu, and Jean-Louis Dessalles

source_refs.excerpt: Make the failure certificate verifier an explicit finite input/output specification
define the input encoding, prove a canonical certificate-size bound

open_problems.why_unsolved: Existing verified encodings exploit binary deterministic equations, while available Python-facing work trades exactness for adjustable approximation. In Beckers semantics, an actual input row must be frozen before deleted-parent coordinates are unioned, and every alternate partial state must admit a complete topological solution. The adjacent in-repo certificate work likewise stops at explicit verifier specifications rather than proving semantic equivalence. The first proof step that must change is therefore an arbitrary-domain replay lemma establishing both directions between compiled records and legal actualized simplifications; cost preservation additionally requires showing that normalization neither loses nor duplicates any charged deletion.
open_problems.what_a_resolution_would_look_like: A total compiler and polynomial-time verifier with an explicit encoding bound, an iff theorem between verifier acceptance and canonical Beckers causation, and an optimum-preserving correspondence for nonnegative binary-rational deletion costs.

writing_exemplar.why: Its framing connects formal actual-cause definitions to usable software and foregrounds non-Boolean and stochastic models.
writing_exemplar.motivation_arc: Actual causes provide useful explanations -> exact causal search is computationally difficult -> practical systems need explicit algorithms and checkable outputs -> build a semantics-faithful exact Beckers backend for the tractable structural class

method_exemplars.technique: Expand actualized refinement, legal graph simplification, and generalized local functions definition by definition, using the minimal-extension property as the invariant in both compiler-correctness directions.
method_exemplars.why_closest: Extensional correctness must target these exact semantic clauses, especially the order of actual-row freezing and deleted-parent union.

method_exemplars.technique: Translate structural equations and counterfactual requirements into finite constraints, then prove that satisfying records decode to valid causal witnesses and conversely.
method_exemplars.why_closest: This is the nearest end-to-end correctness pattern for an implemented actual-cause checker, although explicit finite-domain relations must replace Boolean complementation.

method_exemplars.technique: Use topological semantics for acyclic multivalued nondeterministic equations and preservation of the designated actual solution.
method_exemplars.why_closest: The verifier's completion phase must establish precisely this arbitrary-domain solution relation.

open_problems.open_problem: Does singleton Beckers actual-cause existence have a sound-and-complete value-path certificate and linear-arithmetic algorithm when the full causal graph is a polyforest, while remaining NP-complete for bounded-indegree deterministic binary SCMs whose endogenous projection is one directed chain?

source_refs.claim: Defines actual causation through counterfactual dependence in an actualized structural simplification whose graph includes exogenous and endogenous variables, but gives no complexity frontier.
source_refs.author: Sander Beckers
source_refs.venue: Conference on Causal Learning and Reasoning, PMLR 275

source_refs.claim: Proves polynomial-time algorithms for HP weak causes on causal trees and layered graphs defined over the endogenous causal graph.
source_refs.author: Thomas Eiter and Thomas Lukasiewicz

source_refs.claim: Establishes hardness for HP weak and actual causation, but not for Beckers structural-simplification causation or the full-versus-endogenous graph distinction.
source_refs.author: Thomas Eiter and Thomas Lukasiewicz

source_refs.excerpt: State a forest-incidence completeness theorem as the explicit fallback target
bypasses the virtual-edge realization problem central to the published open completeness question

open_problems.why_unsolved: Classical HP tree algorithms propagate contingency information over endogenous-variable graphs, but Beckers makes the full graph and reachability-sensitive edge legality semantic objects. A shared exogenous parent can correlate multiple chain positions and create full-graph cycles invisible in the endogenous projection. The adjacent in-repo work identifies the same forest-incidence versus shared-exogenous transmission boundary, but its native-forest recursion does not establish Beckers-safe value relations. The missing positive step is a composition theorem proving that retained-parent hitting constraints and safe transitions suffice along the unique full-graph path; the missing negative step is a clause-gate reduction whose Boolean choices arise solely from legal deletions through shared exogenous selectors.
open_problems.what_a_resolution_would_look_like: A classification theorem giving an exact value-path certificate and O(L)-arithmetic decision procedure with polynomial bit complexity on full causal polyforests, plus a polynomial reduction proving NP-completeness on actual-zero deterministic binary endogenous chains of total indegree at most four.

writing_exemplar.why: Its motivation moves from general actual-cause hardness to a graph-restricted tractability frontier and isolates the structural property used by the algorithm.
writing_exemplar.motivation_arc: Actual-cause reasoning is hard in general -> causal graphs expose decomposable instances -> tree structure permits local propagation under HP semantics -> determine the corresponding full-graph frontier for Beckers semantics

method_exemplars.technique: Propagate locally admissible value sets through a causal-tree decomposition and prove soundness and completeness inductively along the unique path.
method_exemplars.why_closest: A Beckers polyforest certificate must likewise compose finite local relations, augmented with legal deletion and nondeterministic safety data.

method_exemplars.technique: Use actualized-refinement semantics and the generalized local relation formed by unioning outputs over deleted-parent values.
method_exemplars.why_closest: These definitions determine the local bad-row supports, safe transitions, and legal graph operations that the certificate must encode.

method_exemplars.technique: Encode Boolean satisfiability into counterfactual causal conditions and establish membership through polynomially checkable witnesses.
method_exemplars.why_closest: The desired lower bound also needs a SAT encoding, but must realize assignments through shared exogenous selector roots and legal edge deletions rather than HP contingencies.

open_problems.open_problem: Can Beckers's qualitative ordering of structural simplifications be refined by nonnegative rational edge-deletion costs so that minimum-cost singleton causation has an additive optimum certificate and a polynomial-bit dynamic program on full causal polyforests?

source_refs.claim: Treats progressively stronger structural simplification as progressively more abnormal, but does not define or optimize heterogeneous edge costs.
source_refs.author: Sander Beckers
source_refs.venue: Conference on Causal Learning and Reasoning, PMLR 275

source_refs.claim: Quantifies removed-edge causal influence by relative-entropy loss after replacing deleted inputs by independent copies; Beckers cites its edge-removal construction.
source_refs.author: Dominik Janzing, David Balduzzi, Moritz Grosse-Wentrup, and Bernhard Schölkopf

source_refs.claim: Encodes binary HP causal checking and inference as ILP and MaxSAT optimization, minimizing causes or contingencies rather than Beckers edge-deletion cost.
source_refs.author: Amjad Ibrahim and Alexander Pretschner
source_refs.venue: Automated Technology for Verification and Analysis, LNCS 12302

open_problems.why_unsolved: Beckers supplies the legal deletion semantics but only an ordinal normality account; Janzing et al. quantify edge removal distributionally; Ibrahim and Pretschner optimize HP contingencies in binary models. None shows that arbitrary rational local deletion costs are certificate-additive under actualized nondeterministic refinement. The concrete missing lemma must prove that local retained-parent hitting choices and path-transition choices neither double-count deletions nor require globally correlated completions, while a bit-complexity argument must prevent rational arithmetic from growing superpolynomially.
open_problems.what_a_resolution_would_look_like: A min-cost theorem equating the semantic optimum with a dynamic-program value over local certificate states, returning an optimal certificate or dual separating cut and bounding every intermediate rational's bit length polynomially in the explicit input.

writing_exemplar.why: Its simplicity-versus-interventional-richness narrative directly motivates making degrees of structural abnormality operational.
writing_exemplar.motivation_arc: Actual causation is dependence in a plausible simplification -> deleting more structure makes a model less normal -> applications must compare heterogeneous simplifications -> compute the least-cost simplification witnessing the cause

method_exemplars.technique: Formalize edge removal locally at affected mechanisms and prove global properties of the resulting cut-edge model.
method_exemplars.why_closest: It is the nearest established semantics for attaching quantitative significance to causal-edge removal, although the destination objective is event-specific witness cost rather than KL loss.

method_exemplars.technique: Compile causal feasibility into hard constraints, attach a weighted objective to witness choices, and prove that solver optima decode into minimum causal explanations.
method_exemplars.why_closest: The desired optimizer likewise separates semantic feasibility from additive cost, but its choices are retained or deleted edges and alternate path values.

method_exemplars.technique: Use a finite local state space and bottom-up composition on a unique-path causal structure.
method_exemplars.why_closest: Weighted value-path certificate states are the natural optimization analogue of unweighted causal-tree propagation.

open_problems.open_problem: Under exactly which coordinate-constant parent additions and inert shared-exogenous completions are Beckers structural-simplification cause verdicts and minimum deletion costs invariant?

source_refs.excerpt: coordinate-constant extensions preserve every observational and interventional law
adds each missing parent ... and makes the structural function constant in that coordinate

open_problems.why_unsolved: The donor exactification preserves observational and interventional laws because each added coordinate is functionally inert, but Beckers causation is sensitive to the declared full graph and the set of legally deletable edges. Thus the donor inference from unchanged structural values to unchanged target semantics fails: an inert edge may change reachability closure, admissible refinements, certificate multiplicity, or deletion cost. The first new proof step must construct a certificate-level map and show that it preserves legality and charged edges, or isolate the precise full-graph obstruction.
open_problems.what_a_resolution_would_look_like: An iff invariance theorem giving a cost-preserving bijection between normalized legal certificates before and after inert completion, or a smallest explicit counterexample paired with a necessary-and-sufficient obstruction in full-graph reachability terms.

writing_exemplar.why: Its graph-sensitive simplification semantics provides the natural framing for why interventionally inert syntax can still affect an actual-cause judgment.
writing_exemplar.motivation_arc: Causally equivalent models may differ syntactically -> ordinary interventions can ignore coordinate-constant parents -> structural simplification treats graph edges as manipulable objects -> characterize when inert graph completion preserves cause certificates and their costs

method_exemplars.technique: Prove preservation through a commuting correspondence between models, contexts, and allowed interventions, then test necessity by breaking individual correspondence conditions.
method_exemplars.why_closest: The desired result also asks when two model presentations preserve a graph-native causal judgment, but the commuting square must include deletion legality and certificate cost.

method_exemplars.technique: Track induced graphical structure and shared exogenous inputs explicitly while comparing finite SCM model classes.
method_exemplars.why_closest: The obstruction to invariance is expected to lie in full-graph incidence and shared-source reachability rather than in observable or interventional laws.

method_exemplars.technique: Represent finite structural models by canonical response tables and perform exact witness comparison over the resulting finite state space.
method_exemplars.why_closest: This provides a route to certify minimal counterexamples and test a proposed certificate-preserving map extensionally.

literature_map:
Beckers (2025, CLeaR, arXiv:2503.07849) introduces actualized refinement, structural simplification, and actual causation as dependence in a simplification, but gives no algorithmic complexity classification.
Beckers (2025, CLeaR, arXiv:2405.14001) supplies finite-domain nondeterministic SCM semantics and requires preservation of the designated actual solution.
Beckers (2021, Journal of Philosophical Logic, arXiv:2102.02311) develops the sufficient-set account that motivates the later structural-simplification semantics.
Halpern and Pearl (2005, British Journal for the Philosophy of Science, DOI:10.1093/bjps/axi147) provide the foundational deterministic SCM actual-cause account, using contingencies rather than structural deletion.
Eiter and Lukasiewicz (2002, Artificial Intelligence, DOI:10.1016/S0004-3702(02)00271-0) establish classical HP hardness but do not analyze Beckers simplifications.
Eiter and Lukasiewicz (2006, Artificial Intelligence, DOI:10.1016/j.artint.2005.12.003) obtain tractability on endogenous causal trees and layered graphs, creating the closest analogue and the central full-versus-endogenous tension.
Aleksandrowicz, Chockler, Halpern, and Ivrii (2014, AAAI, arXiv:1412.3076) show that small changes to an actual-causation definition can alter its exact complexity.
Ibrahim, Rehwald, and Pretschner (2019, arXiv:1904.13101) give sound SAT encodings for binary acyclic HP models and leave broader model classes outside the proved compiler contract.
Ibrahim and Pretschner (2020, ATVA, arXiv:2006.03363) cast binary HP checking and inference as ILP/MaxSAT optimization, but optimize causes and contingencies rather than deleted edges.
Reyd, Diaconescu, and Dessalles (2025, arXiv:2507.07857) provide adjustable approximate algorithms for the actualcauses package and emphasize the scarcity of algorithms for non-Boolean and stochastic models.
Janzing, Balduzzi, Grosse-Wentrup, and Schölkopf (2013, Annals of Statistics, arXiv:1203.6502) quantify causal edge removal by relative-entropy loss, offering a quantitative but distributional contrast to event-specific deletion costs.
Beckers and Halpern (2019, AAAI, arXiv:1812.03789) and Beckers, Eberhardt, and Halpern (2020, UAI, arXiv:1906.11583) formalize exact and approximate causal abstraction, but no commutation theorem with structural simplification was located.
Khan, Lespérance, and Rostamigiv (2025, AAAI, arXiv:2412.16728) develop possible and certain causes in nondeterministic action domains and explicitly flag temporal features whose representation in Beckers NSCMs is unclear.
